name: Object Detection (YOLOX / ONNX)
purpose: Detect objects in one image and return each as {class, class_id, score, box{x,y,width,height}} with a REAL per-detection confidence (YOLOX objectness * class probability). Runs a staged ONNX detector (default detect.yolox.nano, COCO-80) via onnxruntime in a Python worker (detect_worker.py) under the system python and reads its meta file (worker+meta hand-off). Resolves the detector from models.json (type=detector), decoupled from the gateway's wired gate. Default CPU execution provider -> no port/VRAM/CUDA binding, so parallel_safe. Populates confidence + model_provenance and routes low-confidence / no-object results to the review queue (sixth producer). Can compose capture.screen (Module 6) as its input (-Capture) and image.util (Module 15) to downscale a very large input then rescale boxes back (-MaxDimension).

invocation.args_spec: Named params -InputFile <path> (image; required unless -Capture); -Model <model_id> | -Tier <nano|tiny>; -ScoreThreshold <0..1> (detection floor, default 0.25); -ConfidenceThreshold <0..1> (review + low_confidence mark, default 0.5); -NmsThreshold <0..1> (default 0.45); -MaxDetections <n> (default 100); -Classes <name,...> (COCO class filter); -Provider <cpu|cuda|dml> (default cpu); -MaxDimension <n> (downscale via image.util then rescale boxes); -MaxReviewDetections <n>; -MinImagePixels <n>; -Capture; -CaptureInputsJson '<json>'; overrides -Registry/-ModelPath/-DetectWorkerPath/-PythonPath/-ImageUtilPath/-CapturePath/-PwshPath/-ReviewQueuePath. OR -InputsJson '<json {input,model,tier,score_threshold,confidence_threshold,nms_threshold,max_detections,classes,provider,max_dimension,max_review_detections,min_image_pixels,capture,capture_inputs,registry,model_path,detect_worker_path,python_path,image_util_path,capture_path,pwsh_path,review_queue_path}>'. Optional -ArtifactRoot, -InvocationId.

inputs.name: input
inputs.description: Path to the source image (anything Pillow can open: jpg/png/bmp/webp/tif/...). Required unless capture=true.

inputs.name: model
inputs.description: Detector model_id in models.json (type=detector). Default = defaults.detector (detect.yolox.nano).

inputs.name: tier
inputs.description: Detector tier alias resolved via tiers.detector (nano | tiny). A named -Model wins.

inputs.name: score_threshold
inputs.description: Minimum detection score to report a box at all (the detector confidence floor).

inputs.name: confidence_threshold
inputs.description: Overall (best) confidence below this routes the result to the review queue (verify_detections); per-detection scores below it are marked low_confidence.

inputs.name: nms_threshold
inputs.description: IoU threshold for class-aware non-max suppression.

inputs.name: max_detections
inputs.description: Cap on returned detections (highest score first).

inputs.name: classes
inputs.description: Optional COCO class-name filter (e.g. [person, car]); unknown names are warned and ignored.

inputs.name: provider
inputs.description: onnxruntime execution provider: cpu (default, parallel_safe) | cuda | dml. cuda/dml bind the GPU and are NOT parallel_safe.

inputs.name: max_dimension
inputs.description: When set and the image's longest side exceeds it, downscale via image.util (Module 15) before detection, then rescale boxes back to original pixels.

inputs.name: max_review_detections
inputs.description: Cap on the worst detections carried in a low-confidence review item (worst-score first).

inputs.name: min_image_pixels
inputs.description: A zero-detection result only emits a verify_no_objects review item when width*height >= this.

inputs.name: capture
inputs.description: When true and no input is given, compose capture.screen (Module 6) to produce the image, then detect on it.

inputs.name: capture_inputs
inputs.description: Inputs object passed to capture.screen when capture=true (default: primary monitor).
